title: AutoPay Standing and the Reduced Payment Plan
content:
## The rule

For a Reduced Payment Plan of the Hardship Assistance Programs, a loan with AutoPay enrolled on the decision date and no returned AutoPay debit in the six calendar months before it earns 2 points; a loan with AutoPay enrolled and at least one returned AutoPay debit in those six months earns 1 point; a loan without AutoPay earns none. A returned debit counts as inside those six months when fewer than six whole calendar months separate its date from the decision date. AutoPay enrollment and returned AutoPay debits are read from the borrower's Personal Loans record and its payment ledger. Each point is one percentage point off the percentage at which the Reduced Payment Plan installment is set.

## Truth table

| AutoPay enrolled on the decision date | Returned AutoPay debit in the six months | Points |
|---|---|---|
| yes | none | 2 |
| yes | one or more | 1 |
| no | none | none |
| no | one or more | none |

## Hypothetical edge

Decision date 10 September: a returned AutoPay debit dated 11 March is inside the six months (fewer than six whole months); one dated 10 March is exactly six months back and outside, so an enrolled loan whose only return is dated 10 March earns 2 points.
